pack.name: Clonedivers pack
pack.notes: Clone Wars / Republic / 501st Legion / Phase 2. Built for Helldivers 2 patch 7.0.2. Adds the Lighter textures toggle: same mods, textures streamed from disk for 16 GB PCs.

options.name: Lighter textures
options.description: Same mods, same look: textures stream in from disk on demand instead of all sitting in RAM (about 4.5 GB less resident memory). For 16 GB PCs. Built by tools\optimize-pack.ps1, lossless. New in r4 and lightly tested: switch it off if anything looks wrong.
